introHtml: Folding BBQ grilling products save space and make transport easy, whether you're tailgating, camping, or hosting a company picnic. The Cuisinart 4-Piece Folding Grill Tool Set packs neatly into a carrying case, while the Petite Gourmet Portable Gas Grill folds flat for storage. Customize these items with your logo for a practical giveaway that gets used again and again.
